comment: Copperbell Mines casters (BNpcBase 1397): 1051 HP, level 17, casting 968 (0.7 s) every 3.1 s instead of auto-attacking. From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Copperbell Mines (2026-10-25): one run with Duty Support (bd298651, visit 0.5) and two Duty Finder runs (69bea0b9, visits 0.1 and 0.3), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
